what: A 6-track performance groovebox enhanced from Felucca. Adds 2 LFOs with sequencer trigs, retriggering envelopes, mixer and track sequencing views with quick-access controls, multi-track note hold, LED-assisted chord-mode, and a redesigned UI optimized for live use.
